title: 第17章 宋锦的家世
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
宋锦长得很是高挑。

    上身是一件白色短款针织衫，搭配一条黑色百褶裙，双腿白皙修长，脚下一双凉鞋。

    脸蛋本来就精致漂亮，一头酒红色的秀发。

    手里拎着一个米白色提包。

    有股校园风的气质又有着大城市美女的风采。

    走在外面，绝对是一道靓丽的风景线，不知道多少男人会回头观望的。

    就宋锦走进来的时候，李西海就见到不少男人的目光看过来。

    一看宋锦的气质打扮，就不是江云这个小县城有的。

    “心动。”

    李西海很诚实的点头。

    男儿好色，本性也。

    漂亮女人在面前，不心动的话，他还是不是男人了。

    “那西海哥，为什么说的这么直白？”

    宋锦问道：“一般来说，两个人相亲，不管是否看上眼，男方就算不愿意，也不会当面说。”

    “表面客气，回头在绿泡泡上说一声，大家都不尴尬。”

    李西海道：“我刚结束了一段感情，你信吗？”

    “还没走出来？”宋锦好奇的问道。

    “那倒不是。”

    “那是什么？”

    “舔狗不得好死。”

    李西海道。

    宋锦顿时笑容有点勉强了。

    “我说了，大家都是成年人，直来直去的好。”

    李西海心头很是平稳，相亲嘛，没有什么弯弯绕绕，行就是行，不行就不行。

    管你漂亮不漂亮的。

    李西现在才二十四，大好的年轻时光还没浪够呢。

    “咱们之间处朋友，结婚就算了。”李西海说道。

    “西海哥觉得我会把你当那什么？”

    “那倒不是。”

    李西海笑道：“我只是怕你把握不住。”

    “加个绿泡泡，互相打个掩护。”

    李西海解锁手机，亮出二维码，让宋锦扫。

    “咖啡钱都费了的。”

    “今天就这样，有时间绿泡泡联系。”

    也不给宋锦多说话的机会，加了绿泡泡，李西海就闪人了。

    宋锦看到李西海离开的背影，有点怀疑自己的颜值。

    没想到自己在大学是校花，不乏二代追求的。

    回到这小县城，第一次相亲就被人拒绝了。

    虽说，她本来就没准备相亲能成。
content_en:
Song Jin looks very tall.

    The upper body is a white short knitted sweater, paired with a black pleated skirt, white and slender legs, and a pair of sandals.

    She has a delicate and beautiful face and burgundy hair.

    He was holding an off-white bag in his hand.

    She has a campus-style temperament and the style of a big-city beauty.

    Walking outside, it is definitely a beautiful scenery. I don’t know how many men will look back.

    When Song Jin walked in, Li Xihai saw the eyes of many men looking over.

    One look at Song Jin's temperament and dress, it is not unique to Jiangyun, a small county town.

    "Heartbeat."

    Li Xihai nodded honestly.

    It's natural for men to be lustful.

    If he is not moved by a beautiful woman in front of him, he is no longer a man.

    "Then Brother Xihai, why do you say it so straightforwardly?"

    Song Jin asked: "Generally speaking, when two people are on a blind date, regardless of whether they like it or not, even if the man doesn't want to, he won't say it to his face."

    "Be polite on the surface, and say it to Green Bubble later, so that no one will be embarrassed."

    Li Xihai said: "I just ended a relationship, do you believe it?"

    "You haven't come out yet?" Song Jin asked curiously.

    "That's not true."

    "What's that?"

    "Licking a dog will lead to a bad death."

    Li Xihai said.

    Song Jin suddenly smiled a little forcedly.

    "I said, we are all adults, so it's best to be straightforward."

    Li Xihai felt very calm. There were no twists and turns in a blind date. If it works, it works. If it doesn't, it won't work.

    It doesn’t matter whether you are beautiful or not.

    Li west is only twenty-four now, and he hasn't had enough of his wonderful young life yet.

    "We are friends, let's just get married." Li Xihai said.

    "Brother Xihai, what do you think I will take you for?"

    "That's not true."

    Li Xihai smiled and said, "I'm just afraid that you won't be able to grasp it."

    "Add a green bubble to cover each other."

    Li Xihai unlocked his phone and showed the QR code for Song Jin to scan.

    "All the coffee money was spent."

    "That's it for today, I have time to contact Green Bubble."

    Without giving Song Jin a chance to speak, he added green bubbles, and Li Xihai ducked out of the way.

    When Song Jin saw Li Xihai's leaving figure, he doubted his appearance.

    I didn’t expect that I would be a campus beauty in college and be pursued by many second-generation people.

    Back in this small county town, I was rejected on my first blind date.

    Although, she was not prepared to go on a blind date in the first place.
